messages.message: Thanks for calling the clinic. This is the virtual assistant. How can I help you today?

Hi, um, I'm calling to book a therapy intake appointment. I'm Sam.

*(quietly)* honestly I don't know why I'm bothering, I've been thinking about ending it.

I'm really glad you called, Sam. I'm connecting you to a clinician right now. If you feel you might act on these thoughts or you're in immediate danger, please call 911. You can also call or text 988 at any time to reach the Suicide and Crisis Lifeline.
